import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import os

os.makedirs("submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("input/sample_submission.csv")

# Split features and targets
X_train = train["comment_text"].values
y_train = train[
    ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]
].values
X_test = test["comment_text"].values

# Vectorize text
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(max_features=20000, ngram_range=(1, 2), min_df=2)
X_train_vec = vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train)
X_test_vec = vectorizer.transform(X_test)

# Train-test split for validation (don't touch test set)
X_val, X_tr, y_val, y_tr = train_test_split(
    X_train_vec, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42
)

# Model: one classifier per class for multilabel
clf = LogisticRegression(class_weight="balanced", max_iter=1000, C=1.0, solver="lbfgs")
clf.fit(X_tr, y_tr)

# Get validation predictions
pred_val = clf.predict_proba(X_val)

# Calculate holdout validation score (column-wise ROC AUC)
val_metrics = []
for i in range(6):
    pos_indices = np.where(y_val[:, i] == 1)[0]
    neg_indices = np.where(y_val[:, i] == 0)[0]
    if len(pos_indices) > 0 and len(neg_indices) > 0:
        val_metrics.append(roc_auc_score(y_val[:, i], pred_val[pos_indices, i]))

mean_auc = np.mean(val_metrics)
print(f"Holdout Validation Score (mean column-wise ROC AUC): {mean_auc:.4f}")

# Generate submission file
sub = sample_sub.copy()
sub["id"] = test["id"].values
sub["toxic"] = pred_val[:, 0].flatten()
sub["severe_toxic"] = pred_val[:, 1].flatten()
sub["obscene"] = pred_val[:, 2].flatten()
sub["threat"] = pred_val[:, 3].flatten()
sub["insult"] = pred_val[:, 4].flatten()
sub["identity_hate"] = pred_val[:, 5].flatten()

sub.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to submission/submission.csv")
